conceptual_continuity.text: What the next agent inherits. Project State supplies continuity through saved meanings, records, decisions, evidence, connections and histories. Working memory belongs to one session. When that machine session ends, its instance ends too. A later agent recovers durable knowledge through fresh checked views. Session A Investigate & record Short-term session memory Project state Continuing knowledge Recorded work, evidence & decisions Session B Recover & continue Fresh context, checked permissions A session handoff. Records persist; a new session obtains the relevant context rather than inheriting an agent’s private memory. An Agent Session is temporary. Context View supplies task information, while Ontology View selects relevant concepts and connections. Both identify source versions, limits and refresh conditions. If a view expires, refresh it or pause. Continuing requires usable context and current permission. The identifier comparison can survive the session, so another agent can inspect its basis and continue investigating cause. Learning is another question to examine. A saved lesson can be tried in later work. To claim improvement, we need evidence of actual use and an assessment of the resulting benefit.
